/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, LineChart, Reference
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Border, Side, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart.label import DataLabelList

path = '/home/user/SalesRep.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active

# Clear any existing charts to keep reruns deterministic.
ws._charts = []

# Add calculation rows.
ws['A12'] = 'Total'
ws['A13'] = 'Growth'
for col in range(2, 8):  # B:G, Jan:Jun
    letter = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).column_letter
    ws.cell(row=12, column=col).value = f'=SUM({letter}2:{letter}11)'

# Month-on-month growth: Feb through Jun only. Jan intentionally omitted/blank.
ws['B13'] = None
for col in range(3, 8):  # C:G, Feb:Jun
    letter = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).column_letter
    prev_letter = ws.cell(row=1, column=col - 1).column_letter
    cell = ws.cell(row=13, column=col)
    cell.value = f'=({letter}12-{prev_letter}12)/{prev_letter}12'
    cell.number_format = '0.00%'

# Light table styling for the new rows.
bold = Font(bold=True)
fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='EAF2F8')
thin_top = Border(top=Side(style='thin', color='808080'))
for row in (12, 13):
    for col in range(1, 8):
        c = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        c.font = bold
        c.fill = fill
        c.border = thin_top
        c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center' if col > 1 else 'left')

# Make row labels/months visible.
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = max(ws.column_dimensions['A'].width or 0, 18)
for col in 'BCDEFG':
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = max(ws.column_dimensions[col].width or 0, 11)

# Total bar chart: Jan-Jun totals.
bar = BarChart()
bar.type = 'col'
bar.style = 10
bar.title = 'Total'
bar.y_axis.title = 'Sales'
bar.x_axis.title = 'Month'
bar.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_col=7, min_row=12, max_row=12), from_rows=True, titles_from_data=False)
bar.set_categories(Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_col=7, min_row=1, max_row=1))
bar.legend = None
bar.height = 7.5
bar.width = 15
ws.add_chart(bar, 'I2')

# Growth line chart: Feb-Jun growth only; Jan omitted.
line = LineChart()
line.style = 13
line.title = 'Growth'
line.y_axis.title = 'Growth %'
line.x_axis.title = 'Month'
line.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=3, max_col=7, min_row=13, max_row=13), from_rows=True, titles_from_data=False)
line.set_categories(Reference(ws, min_col=3, max_col=7, min_row=1, max_row=1))
line.legend = None
line.height = 7.5
line.width = 15
line.y_axis.numFmt = '0%'
line.dLbls = DataLabelList()
line.dLbls.showVal = False
ws.add_chart(line, 'I18')

# Encourage recalculation when opened by spreadsheet apps.
wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
wb.calculation.calcMode = 'auto'

wb.save(path)
print('updated', path)
PY"
